page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes with line numbers 5 and 10 at the right edge of the column; a heading block centred below the text; a faint show-through of the reverse page (not transcribed); a manuscript annotation strip on the far right edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: Aristotelis scripta rescriptaque est, eandem mil-lies a Rhetoribus non dissectam generibus, & partibus novis explicatam, sed eadem prorsus mutatis quibusdam verbis & exemplis, odiosissima & importunissima tautologia positam & 5 repositam. Quamobrem fortiter ad extremum P. Ramus pro regia suscepta professionis vigilia custodiaq;, leges illas sanctas & sacras, & a se pro Logicę salute & dignitate juratas tuebatur, concludebatq;, infinitas inventionis artes pro 10 una generali & universali non esse catholicas, ideoq; tollendas.
main_text.head: P. RAMI DIALECTICAE LIBRI PRIMI FINIS.
PETRI

page.notes: The faint text in the lower half of the page is show-through from the reverse side and was not transcribed. The word "dissectam" may be a misprint for "dissectam"/"dissertam"; read as printed. The final line of the heading block is partly faint; "PETRI" is the start of the next division title, the remainder being absent from this scan.
